lines.speaker: player
lines.text: There, we're safe. Can you sit up, Silas?

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: I think so... Wait. Where's my tail?! These are... legs?!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You changed when I brought you onto land. Are you feeling any better?

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: A little. I'm still shaking... but you really carried me all the way here?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Of course. Come on, I'll find you somewhere warm to rest.

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: ...Thank you, Penni. I don't know what I'd have done without you.
